event_summary: A distant rail vehicle remains on the tracks while a large white plume above it changes shape and spreads upward and leftward.
raw_event_description: The view shows railway tracks running from the foreground toward a distant rail vehicle near the right side of the scene. A large white plume is already present above the vehicle at the start. Over time the plume grows wider, its outline changes, and its upper portion extends upward and toward the left. The rail vehicle remains small and distant, with only slight visible change in its position and size. The surrounding hillside, house, poles, overhead wires, tracks, gravel, grass, and trees remain visually stable.

reasons: The rail vehicle is distant and partly visually overlapped by the white plume and nearby vegetation.
The tracks, landscape, and plume source area are visible from the beginning.
The plume is already present in the first visible frame.
